text:
bri: quick design sync — users get lost when many tiny rollouts appear in timeline. thinking: add a small 'scope' label on each version chip: 'full', 'config', 'weights', 'tokenizer'. makes impact visible at a glance.

omar: engineering ok with label. we can add a short tag and a tooltip with exact changed keys. will be cheap to compute.

sasha: accessibility: don't depend on color. include text and aria-describedby linking to the tooltip content. for TTS, the chip should say e.g., 'v14, config change, 3% traffic'.

bri: interaction idea: long-press or keyboard modifier opens a compact diff inline instead of full panel. good for quick scans.

derek: microcopy: what about 'Scope: Config' vs 'Config change'? shorter is better in chip. prefer 'Config'.

faye: for rollback verbs, current 'Rollback' scares product owners. alternatives: 'Pause rollout', 'Revert to v13', and in danger flows show 'Revert (full)'. primary action should be conservative.

omar: can add an 'Affected scope' line in confirmation modal so users know whether revert affects weights or global config.

a11y-bot: checklist: ensure chip role is button when interactive, provide focus-visible, and announce expanded diff summary on open.

sasha: SR copy suggestion for chip tooltip: 'Change scope: Config. Files: deploy.yaml, limits.json.' keep items comma separated.

bri: small footer hint under timeline: 'Tip: scope labels help you judge impact quickly. Click a chip for details.' add 'Learn more' link to docs.

derek: one more: allow filtering timeline by scope (checkboxes) so infra folks can see only config or weight changes.

faye: agree — add filter UI to toolbar; accessible labels: 'Filter by change scope'.

bri: ok can we mock small chip states (default, focused, expanded) and the filter dropdown? sasha: add SR strings. omar: API will return scope and file list.

sasha: on it; will post SR snippets in 30m.

bri: thanks all :thumbsup: locking thread until mocks are uploaded.
